title: How this data was cleaned reproducibility explainer for the public
context: A future-backlog public-facing explainer supporting open-science literacy: a plain-language How this data was cleaned account that walks the public through the reproducible cleaning process and the provenance record. It is a secondary benefit that makes the transparent, auditable method legible to non-experts. No PII or sensitive coordinates appear in any example.
objective: Write a plain-language reproducibility explainer for the public describing how a citizen-science dataset is cleaned, validated, de-identified, and made reproducible, using only synthetic or openly-licensed examples.
acceptanceCriteria: Plain-language explainer covering validation, non-destructive cleaning, de-identification, and reproducibility/provenance
Uses only synthetic or openly-licensed examples; no PII or sensitive coordinates shown
Links the explainer to an actual run manifest so a reader can see the reproducible record
Reviewed for accuracy against the charter and core invariants
output: docs/public/how-this-data-was-cleaned.md committed as the public reproducibility explainer.
